SYSTEM_WHATSAPP_DOWN.loggedOutBody: This usually happens when someone unlinks the device from the official WhatsApp app. The system cannot reconnect on its own in this case — you need to scan a new QR code.
SYSTEM_WHATSAPP_DOWN.waitingQrBanner: ⚠️ WhatsApp requested a new QR code.
SYSTEM_WHATSAPP_DOWN.waitingQrBody: The session expired or was invalidated. To resume sending, open settings and scan the QR.
SYSTEM_WHATSAPP_DOWN.connectionLostBody: The WhatsApp connection dropped and the system is trying to reconnect automatically.
SYSTEM_WHATSAPP_DOWN.attemptsHint: If it doesn't come back in a few minutes, open the panel to check.
SYSTEM_WHATSAPP_DOWN.textLoggedOut:
⚠ Action required: WhatsApp disconnected

The WhatsApp session was closed. The system cannot reconnect on its own — you need to scan a new QR code.
SYSTEM_WHATSAPP_DOWN.textWaitingQr:
⚠ Action required: WhatsApp requested a new QR code

The session expired or was invalidated. Open settings and scan the QR to resume sending.
